acceptance_checks.description: customers holds exactly 25000 documents for ns=demo, one per CUSTOMER_MASTER row, keyed by a deterministic _id derived from CUSTOMER_ID (uuid5, never uuid4).
All 8333 ENTITY_ATTR_VALUE rows fold into the owning customer's attributes subdocument; no EAV row is dropped, and attribute names are preserved verbatim (including TAX_REGION_OVERRIDE).
RELATED_ACCT_IDS and PROMO_CODES_CSV become real BSON arrays; a well-formed empty list becomes an empty array, never a null or a one-element array containing an empty string.
Valid DD-MON-YY SIGNUP_DT strings become BSON dates in UTC; the 50 dirty values are quarantined, never coerced, defaulted, or silently nulled.
Sparse legacy columns (ADDR_LINE_1..6, PHONE1..4, FLAG_01..20, UDF_01..40) are emitted only when the source value is non-null; absent fields are omitted rather than written as null.
customers carries a $jsonSchema validator that rejects a string signup_dt and rejects an unknown top-level field such as tax_region_override; rejection is proven with server error 121 evidence.
Recon recomputes the manifest's line-format md5 checksum 4f92feef2ad58dbab30e289957931928 from the Atlas collection and matches it exactly.
Re-running the migration for ns=demo reproduces identical counts, checksums, and quarantine sets with no duplicate documents.

encoding_policy.byte_transparency: Text values are carried through byte-for-byte after decoding; no normalization, case folding, or whitespace trimming.
encoding_policy.invalid_bytes: A value that cannot be decoded as UTF-8 is quarantined with reason invalid_encoding and its raw bytes recorded as hex; it is never replaced with U+FFFD and never silently dropped.

malformed_record_policy.details: Malformed CSV list entries are tolerated: the document is written with the parsable elements and the row is attributed in the quarantine collection with the raw source string and a reason code. A NULL or missing source value may never fail open into a valid-looking document: if a required target field has no source value, the record is quarantined rather than defaulted.

empty_input_semantics.details: A run over an empty source set leaves prior output untouched and exits zero; it never truncates or drops customers.

planted_anomalies.description: 50 dirty SIGNUP_DT strings in oracle.OW_BILLING.CUSTOMER_MASTER.SIGNUP_DT (e.g. 31-FEB-24, N/A) must be surfaced as an exact set of 50 quarantined customers.
31 malformed RELATED_ACCT_IDS lists must be surfaced as an exact set of 31 attributed records.
